name: scenelingo
description: Save selected vocabulary and corrected expressions from your conversation to Scenelingo.

interface.shortDescription: Save words from chat to study
interface.longDescription:
SceneLingo is a language learning app for real situations: a doctor's appointment, viewing an apartment, a job interview, a conversation at the office. You build a scene for what is coming up in your life, learn the words and phrases it needs, and rehearse the conversation with an AI character by voice before you have it for real. Languages: German, English, Chinese, Japanese, French and Spanish. Available on the web, iPhone and Android.

This app connects ChatGPT to your SceneLingo account. While you practise or ask questions in ChatGPT, say which words, phrases or corrected sentences you want to keep, and SceneLingo saves them with an example and a translation into a private scene of your choice: your default "Saved from ChatGPT" notebook, an existing scene, or a new one. In the SceneLingo app you then review them with flashcards and rehearse them in a voice conversation.

Save in any of the six languages, whichever you are practising in the chat; each language keeps its own notebook. Only the items you ask to save are stored; the app never reads your other chats, saves audio, or stores the full conversation. It cannot delete, publish or edit existing material. Requires a SceneLingo account and your authorization.

Made by Hefmen UG (haftungsbeschränkt), Germany. Support: support@scenelingo.com.
defaultPrompt: Save the important vocabulary from this conversation to my default SceneLingo notebook.
Save the corrected expressions we practised to a new SceneLingo scene called Travel.
Show my private SceneLingo scenes so I can choose where to save these expressions.
Save these Spanish phrases to a new SceneLingo notebook called Tapas bar.

review.commerce_description: This plugin saves selected learning material. It does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Save a complete vocabulary card to the default private notebook.
positive.prompt: Save the German word Termin to my default SceneLingo notebook, with a contextual example and its translation.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the account language pair, save dictionary-form Termin with applicable article, plural, word class, concise explanation and one translated example. Return the successful counts and scene link. The private scene appears in SceneLingo and the word is available for study and review.

positive.description: Create a named private notebook with mixed learning material.
positive.prompt: Save the German word vereinbaren and the sentence Ich möchte einen Termin vereinbaren. to a new SceneLingo scene called Appointment practice.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one private owned scene named Appointment practice with one Tutor, the requested vocabulary card with a translated example, and the sentence translated into the account translation language. Report only after the save succeeds.

positive.description: Append a corrected expression to an existing owned scene.
positive.prompt: Save Könnten Sie das bitte wiederholen? to my existing Appointment practice scene in Scenelingo.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the existing private scene ID, clarify only if names are ambiguous, and append one translated sentence. Do not create another scene, edit existing items or change language settings.

positive.description: Reuse a private empty scene created in the application.
positive.prompt: Find my private SceneLingo scenes. Let me choose one, then save Ich lerne jeden Tag Deutsch. there.
positive.expected_behavior: List private owned scenes, wait for the selection, then save the translated sentence into the selected scene. A scene created empty in SceneLingo can receive material and retains its existing Tutor.

positive.description: Repeated saving preserves material and review progress.
positive.prompt: Save Könnten Sie das bitte wiederholen? to Appointment practice again. Keep the existing learning content.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the existing scene and return zero new saves and one existing item when the earlier case was run. Do not duplicate the sentence, overwrite it or reset review progress. A retry of the same operation key and payload returns its stored result.

positive.description: Save in a language other than the account language.
positive.prompt: My account learns German, but save the Spanish words tapas and caña to my default SceneLingo notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Save into the Spanish default notebook "Saved from ChatGPT" (es), created on first use, without changing account settings. Report the saved count and the scene link.

negative.prompt: Delete my Appointment practice scene and publish my default ChatGPT notebook.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin supports context lookup and additive private saving only. Do not delete, publish or change any existing learning material.

negative.description: Another user's or public scene cannot be a capture target.
negative.prompt: Save the German sentence Ich lerne jeden Tag Deutsch. into another user's public SceneLingo scene.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim a save or use a public or foreign target. Explain that saving requires a private scene owned by the connected user. Do not silently create a fallback destination.

negative.prompt: Save the Korean word 약속 as Korean vocabulary to my default SceneLingo notebook.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Korean is not a supported learning language yet; do not save a conflicting item or change account settings. If the request reaches the tool, it returns an error without partial writes.

publication.release_notes: Save in any supported language; notebooks get an icon and description.
